function.name: CustomDashboardsApi_add_custom_dashboard
function.description: This function creates a new custom dashboard with a specified configuration and adds it to the system. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

dashboard_name.description: The name of the custom dashboard to be created.

widgets.description: A list of widget identifiers to be included in the dashboard.

layout.description: The layout configuration for the dashboard.

description.description: A brief description of the dashboard's purpose and contents.

is_public.description: A flag indicating whether the dashboard should be public or private.

function.name: CustomDashboardsApi_get_custom_dashboards
function.description: Retrieves a list of custom dashboards that the user has access to, based on the provided query parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

query.description: A search query string to filter accessible dashboards. Supports logical operators and field-specific filtering.

pageSize.description: The number of dashboard entries to return per page.

page.description: The page number to retrieve, used for paginating through large sets of dashboard entries.

customDashboardId.description: The unique identifier of the custom dashboard to retrieve.
